rows.grounds: locative singular of sūryagraha; sets the temporal condition
causative optative third singular of kṛ; prohibits causing the initiations

items.question: Should śakti-initiation and paśu-initiation be performed during a solar eclipse?
premises: Solar eclipse is the stated condition.
Śakti-initiation and paśu-initiation are named objects.
items.inference: Therefore neither śakti-initiation nor paśu-initiation should be caused during a solar eclipse.
uncertainties: The exact mood of kārayet is not fully specified by the surface form alone.
The implied agent is not named in the verse.
items.plain_english: During a solar eclipse, one should not cause śakti-initiation or paśu-initiation.
